name: Youjuu Club 2
source:
Main hero is an evil wizard. He worships demons from another dimension. It’s your job to use your magic powers, open up a portal to Hell, and let the demons out so that they can feast on the humans.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-august-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名邪恶的巫师。他崇拜来自异次元的恶魔。你的任务是使用魔法力量打开通往地狱的传送门，放出恶魔，让它们饱餐人类。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-august-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
